releaseNotes: What's New in Version 1.0.2: ✨ Sleeker Tour Browsing: Redesigned category cards with crystal-clear text so you can explore Kashmir, Manali, and pilgrimage circuits with ease. 🔔 Instant Travel Alerts: Never miss exclusive tour offers, yatra updates, and seasonal deals with our real-time notifications. 🚀 New Tour Announcements: Get instant alerts the moment fresh holiday and day-trip packages are launched. 🛠️ Performance Boost: Smoother animations, faster booking screen loading, and bug fixes for a hassle-free experience..
